comparisons.peer_summary: Long-term supplier relationships enable the proactive management of technology development and product discontinuance plans, as well as the monitoring of suppliers' financial health.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom discuss proactive management of supplier relationships, though they highlight different aspects. Intel focuses on using direct supplier engagement and audits to verify compliance and build capacity, specifically addressing human rights risks like forced labor. Broadcom emphasizes that long-term supplier relationships enable the management of technology development and product discontinuance plans, as well as monitoring financial health. Both disclosures indicate a strategic, long-term approach to supplier management but Intel’s is compliance/audit-centric while Broadcom’s is operational/financial-centric.

sentences.text: Over the past decade, we have directly engaged with suppliers to verify compliance and build operational capacity to address risks of forced and bonded labor and other human rights issues.
Our long-term relationships with our suppliers allow us to proactively manage our technology development and product discontinuance plans, and to monitor our suppliers' financial health.

comparisons.peer_topic: Responsible Business Alliance Membership and Ethical Standards
comparisons.peer_summary: As a member of the Responsible Business Alliance (RBA), the company strives to adhere to its Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and the RBA code of conduct to promote responsible working conditions and ethical business practices in its global supply chain.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron reference the Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) in the context of supply chain ethics. Intel states it verifies compliance with the RBA and its Code of Conduct through periodic audits and capability-building programs for suppliers. Micron discloses its membership in the RBA and commitment to adhering to the RBA code of conduct alongside its own Code of Business Conduct and Ethics to promote responsible working conditions. While Intel details the audit mechanism, Micron focuses on the membership and ethical commitment, both sharing the RBA framework for supply chain responsibility.

sentences.text: We perform periodic audits and identify critical direct suppliers to engage through capability-building programs, which help suppliers build sustainability acumen and verify compliance with the Responsible Business Alliance and the Intel Code of Conduct.

We strive to adhere to both our Code of Business Conduct and Ethics (available on our website, www.micron.com) and the RBA code of conduct, which is a demonstration of our commitment to integrity and responsible practices.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm's 2025 goals include reducing absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 30% from a 2014 base year, reducing power consumption in flagship Snapdragon Mobile Platform products by 10% annually, and ensuring 100% of primary semiconductor manufacturing suppliers are audited every two years for conformance to the Supplier Code of Conduct.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm disclose specific commitments to supplier auditing and compliance with codes of conduct. Intel mentions performing periodic audits and engaging suppliers to verify compliance with the Responsible Business Alliance and Intel Code of Conduct. Qualcomm lists a 2025 goal to have 100% of its primary semiconductor manufacturing suppliers audited every two years for conformance to its Supplier Code of Conduct. Both companies utilize formal auditing of suppliers against internal or industry-standard codes of conduct as a key risk management activity.
